def f(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])

from collections import Counter
def f(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    rows=[r for r in range(h) if any(x!=bg for x in g[r])]
    blocks=[]; cur=[rows[0]]
    for r in rows[1:]:
        if r==cur[-1]+1: cur.append(r)
        else: blocks.append(cur); cur=[r]
    blocks.append(cur)
    if len(blocks)!=2: return g
    b1,b2=blocks
    if len(b1)!=len(b2): return g
    for r1,r2 in zip(b1,b2):
        for r in (r1,r2):
            full = g[r][w-1]!=bg
            other = r2 if r==r1 else r1
            ofull = g[other][w-1]!=bg
            if full!=ofull and not full:
                last=max(c for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg)
                for c in range(last+1,w): g[r][c]=1
    return g
